name: audit-events
intro: The 194 events OpenCTI 7.260309.0-lts.8 publishes to its activity, with the message each one writes and the function that publishes it; {braces} mark a value of the event. The activity module records them only when Enterprise Edition is on: administration events for every user, extended events only for the users you listen to, as [Activity](/opencti/configure/activity/) explains; read them on the [Activity events](/opencti/configure/activity/events/) screen.
